title: "Module 13: Spatial cell-type deconvolution with CARD"

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 13 — Spatial CARD cell-type deconvolution
#==============================================================================
#
# Purpose:
#   Estimate cell-type proportions within Visium spots using CARD and the
#   SingleR-annotated scRNA-seq reference generated upstream.
#
# CARD is run independently for each tissue section because each slide has its
# own spatial coordinate system. Results are then combined across samples and
# transferred to the master spatial Seurat object.
#
# CARD estimates model-based cell-type proportions. These values should not be
# interpreted as direct cell counts or definitive pure spot identities.
#
# Inputs:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds
#
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds
#
# Output:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR_CARD.rds
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(CARD)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis settings

reference_assay <- "RNA"
reference_cell_type_column <- "SingleR_broad_pruned"
reference_sample_column <- "sample"

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"
spatial_sample_column <- "sample"

CARD_min_count_gene <- 200
CARD_min_count_spot <- 50


sample_order <- c(
  "Normal_Tissue",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2",
  "Niacin_Treatment"
)


sample_images <- c(
  Normal_Tissue = "Naive_A9",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle1_C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle2_D5",
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin2_B5"
)


sample_titles <- c(
  Normal_Tissue = "Normal Tissue",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle 1",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle 2",
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin Treatment"
)


# Continuous color scale used by CARD-native proportion maps.

card_proportion_colors <- c(
  "cornflowerblue",
  "cornsilk",
  "red"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

single_cell_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)

spatial_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

CARD_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "CARD"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "CARD"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "CARD"
)


dir.create(
  CARD_object_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  results_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  figure_directory,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


reference_file <- file.path(
  single_cell_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds"
)

spatial_file <- file.path(
  spatial_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR.rds"
)

CARD_results_file <- file.path(
  CARD_object_directory,
  "spatial_CARD_results.rds"
)

final_CARD_object_file <- file.path(
  spatial_directory,
  "spatial_tumor_final_infercnv_singleR_CARD.rds"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Load reference and spatial objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(reference_file)) {
  stop(
    "Single-cell reference was not found: ",
    reference_file
  )
}

if (!file.exists(spatial_file)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial object was not found: ",
    spatial_file
  )
}


reference_object <- readRDS(reference_file)
spatial_object <- readRDS(spatial_file)


if (!reference_assay %in% names(reference_object@assays)) {
  stop(
    "RNA assay was not found in the single-cell reference."
  )
}

if (!reference_cell_type_column %in% colnames(reference_object@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "SingleR reference annotation was not found: ",
    reference_cell_type_column
  )
}

if (!spatial_assay %in% names(spatial_object@assays)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial assay was not found."
  )
}

if (!spatial_sample_column %in% colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial sample metadata was not found."
  )
}


message(
  "Single-cell reference: ",
  ncol(reference_object),
  " cells."
)

message(
  "Spatial dataset: ",
  ncol(spatial_object),
  " spots."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Prepare scRNA-seq reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

DefaultAssay(reference_object) <- reference_assay


reference_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  reference_object[[reference_assay]]
)


reference_count_layers <- grep(
  "^counts",
  reference_layers,
  value = TRUE
)


if (length(reference_count_layers) > 1) {

  reference_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    reference_object,
    assay = reference_assay
  )
}


reference_counts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
  reference_object,
  assay = reference_assay,
  layer = "counts"
)


reference_cell_types <- as.character(
  reference_object@meta.data[
    colnames(reference_counts),
    reference_cell_type_column
  ]
)


# Remove uncertain or missing SingleR annotations.

valid_reference <- !is.na(reference_cell_types) &
  reference_cell_types != "" &
  reference_cell_types != "Unassigned" &
  reference_cell_types != "Uncertain"


reference_counts <- reference_counts[, valid_reference, drop = FALSE]
reference_cell_types <- reference_cell_types[valid_reference]


# CARD uses sample information from the single-cell reference.

if (reference_sample_column %in% colnames(reference_object@meta.data)) {

  reference_sample_info <- as.character(
    reference_object@meta.data[
      colnames(reference_counts),
      reference_sample_column
    ]
  )

} else {

  reference_sample_info <- rep(
    "reference",
    ncol(reference_counts)
  )
}


reference_metadata <- data.frame(
  cellType = reference_cell_types,
  sampleInfo = reference_sample_info,
  row.names = colnames(reference_counts),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


reference_summary <- reference_metadata %>%
  dplyr::count(
    cellType,
    name = "n_cells"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_cells)
  )


print(reference_summary)


write.csv(
  reference_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "CARD_reference_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Extract CARD-compatible spatial coordinates
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

get_CARD_coordinates <- function(sample_object, image_name) {

  coordinates <- Seurat::GetTissueCoordinates(
    sample_object,
    image = image_name
  )


  coordinate_names <- colnames(coordinates)


  if (all(c("x", "y") %in% coordinate_names)) {

    CARD_coordinates <- coordinates[, c("x", "y"), drop = FALSE]

  } else if (all(c("imagerow", "imagecol") %in% coordinate_names)) {

    CARD_coordinates <- coordinates[
      ,
      c("imagecol", "imagerow"),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    colnames(CARD_coordinates) <- c(
      "x",
      "y"
    )

  } else if (all(c("row", "col") %in% coordinate_names)) {

    CARD_coordinates <- coordinates[, c("col", "row"), drop = FALSE]

    colnames(CARD_coordinates) <- c(
      "x",
      "y"
    )

  } else {

    stop(
      "Could not identify CARD-compatible spatial coordinates."
    )
  }


  CARD_coordinates
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Run CARD independently for each tissue section
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CARD_results <- list()


available_samples <- unique(
  spatial_object@meta.data[[spatial_sample_column]]
)


for (sample_name in sample_order) {

  if (!sample_name %in% available_samples) {
    next
  }


  message(
    "Running CARD: ",
    sample_name
  )


  sample_spots <- colnames(spatial_object)[
    spatial_object@meta.data[[spatial_sample_column]] == sample_name
  ]


  sample_object <- subset(
    spatial_object,
    cells = sample_spots
  )


  image_name <- sample_images[[sample_name]]


  if (!image_name %in% names(sample_object@images)) {
    stop(
      "Spatial image was not found for ",
      sample_name,
      ": ",
      image_name
    )
  }


  # Prepare raw Spatial counts.

  sample_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
    sample_object[[spatial_assay]]
  )


  sample_count_layers <- grep(
    "^counts",
    sample_layers,
    value = TRUE
  )


  if (length(sample_count_layers) > 1) {

    sample_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
      sample_object,
      assay = spatial_assay
    )
  }


  spatial_counts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
    sample_object,
    assay = spatial_assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )


  # Extract tissue coordinates.

  spatial_coordinates <- get_CARD_coordinates(
    sample_object,
    image_name
  )


  common_spots <- intersect(
    colnames(spatial_counts),
    rownames(spatial_coordinates)
  )


  if (length(common_spots) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No matching spatial counts and coordinates for ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )
  }


  spatial_counts <- spatial_counts[, common_spots, drop = FALSE]

  spatial_coordinates <- spatial_coordinates[
    common_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  # Restrict reference and spatial matrices to shared genes.

  shared_genes <- intersect(
    rownames(reference_counts),
    rownames(spatial_counts)
  )


  if (length(shared_genes) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No shared genes were available for CARD in ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )
  }


  sample_reference_counts <- reference_counts[
    shared_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  sample_spatial_counts <- spatial_counts[
    shared_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  message(
    sample_name,
    ": ",
    length(common_spots),
    " spots and ",
    length(shared_genes),
    " shared genes."
  )


  # Create CARD object.

  CARD_object <- CARD::createCARDObject(
    sc_count = sample_reference_counts,
    sc_meta = reference_metadata,
    spatial_count = sample_spatial_counts,
    spatial_location = spatial_coordinates,
    ct.varname = "cellType",
    ct.select = unique(reference_metadata$cellType),
    sample.varname = "sampleInfo",
    minCountGene = CARD_min_count_gene,
    minCountSpot = CARD_min_count_spot
  )


  # Run CARD deconvolution.

  CARD_object <- CARD::CARD_deconvolution(
    CARD_object = CARD_object
  )


  proportions <- as.data.frame(
    CARD_object@Proportion_CARD,
    check.names = FALSE
  )


  if (nrow(proportions) == 0 || ncol(proportions) == 0) {
    stop(
      "CARD returned an empty proportion matrix for ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )
  }


  CARD_results[[sample_name]] <- list(
    CARD_object = CARD_object,
    proportions = proportions,
    coordinates = spatial_coordinates,
    shared_genes = shared_genes
  )


  saveRDS(
    CARD_object,
    file.path(
      CARD_object_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_CARD_object.rds"
      )
    ),
    compress = TRUE
  )


  message(
    "Completed ",
    sample_name,
    ": ",
    nrow(proportions),
    " spots x ",
    ncol(proportions),
    " cell types."
  )
}


if (length(CARD_results) == 0) {
  stop(
    "CARD did not complete successfully for any spatial sample."
  )
}


saveRDS(
  CARD_results,
  CARD_results_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Combine CARD proportions across slides
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CARD_proportion_list <- lapply(
  names(CARD_results),
  function(sample_name) {

    current_proportions <- as.data.frame(
      CARD_results[[sample_name]]$proportions,
      check.names = FALSE
    )


    current_proportions$spot <- rownames(
      current_proportions
    )

    current_proportions$sample <- sample_name


    current_proportions
  }
)


CARD_proportions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  CARD_proportion_list
)


write.csv(
  CARD_proportions,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "CARD_all_spot_proportions.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Calculate predominant and top-three CARD identities
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

assign_CARD_top3 <- function(proportions) {

  proportions <- as.matrix(
    proportions
  )


  ranked_indices <- t(
    apply(
      proportions,
      1,
      order,
      decreasing = TRUE
    )
  )


  if (ncol(ranked_indices) < 3) {
    stop(
      "Fewer than three CARD cell types were available."
    )
  }


  top1 <- ranked_indices[, 1]
  top2 <- ranked_indices[, 2]
  top3 <- ranked_indices[, 3]

  row_index <- seq_len(
    nrow(proportions)
  )


  top1_identity <- colnames(proportions)[top1]
  top2_identity <- colnames(proportions)[top2]
  top3_identity <- colnames(proportions)[top3]

  top1_score <- proportions[cbind(row_index, top1)]
  top2_score <- proportions[cbind(row_index, top2)]
  top3_score <- proportions[cbind(row_index, top3)]


  data.frame(
    CARD_identity = top1_identity,
    CARD_max_score = top1_score,
    CARD_second_identity = top2_identity,
    CARD_second_score = top2_score,
    CARD_third_identity = top3_identity,
    CARD_third_score = top3_score,
    CARD_margin = top1_score - top2_score,
    CARD_top3_total = top1_score + top2_score + top3_score,
    row.names = rownames(proportions),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


CARD_identity_results <- list()


for (sample_name in names(CARD_results)) {

  sample_proportions <- CARD_results[[sample_name]]$proportions

  CARD_identity_results[[sample_name]] <- assign_CARD_top3(
    sample_proportions
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Transfer CARD results to master spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object$CARD_identity <- NA_character_
spatial_object$CARD_max_score <- NA_real_
spatial_object$CARD_second_identity <- NA_character_
spatial_object$CARD_second_score <- NA_real_
spatial_object$CARD_third_identity <- NA_character_
spatial_object$CARD_third_score <- NA_real_
spatial_object$CARD_margin <- NA_real_
spatial_object$CARD_top3_total <- NA_real_


CARD_cell_types <- sort(
  unique(
    unlist(
      lapply(
        CARD_results,
        function(result) {
          colnames(result$proportions)
        }
      )
    )
  )
)


# Initialize proportion metadata columns.

for (cell_type in CARD_cell_types) {

  metadata_column <- paste0(
    "CARD_",
    make.names(cell_type)
  )

  spatial_object@meta.data[[metadata_column]] <- NA_real_
}


# Transfer results sample by sample.

for (sample_name in names(CARD_results)) {

  proportions <- as.data.frame(
    CARD_results[[sample_name]]$proportions,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  identities <- CARD_identity_results[[sample_name]]


  common_spots <- intersect(
    rownames(proportions),
    colnames(spatial_object)
  )


  if (length(common_spots) == 0) {

    warning(
      "No CARD spots matched the master object for ",
      sample_name,
      "."
    )

    next
  }


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_identity"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_identity"]


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_max_score"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_max_score"]


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_second_identity"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_second_identity"]


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_second_score"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_second_score"]


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_third_identity"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_third_identity"]


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_third_score"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_third_score"]


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_margin"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_margin"]


  spatial_object@meta.data[
    common_spots,
    "CARD_top3_total"
  ] <- identities[common_spots, "CARD_top3_total"]


  for (cell_type in colnames(proportions)) {

    metadata_column <- paste0(
      "CARD_",
      make.names(cell_type)
    )


    spatial_object@meta.data[
      common_spots,
      metadata_column
    ] <- proportions[common_spots, cell_type]
  }
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Export spot-level CARD summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CARD_spot_summary <- spatial_object@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "spot"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    spot,
    sample,
    CARD_identity,
    CARD_max_score,
    CARD_second_identity,
    CARD_second_score,
    CARD_third_identity,
    CARD_third_score,
    CARD_margin,
    CARD_top3_total
  )


write.csv(
  CARD_spot_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "CARD_top3_spot_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Whole-slide CARD scatter-pie composition plots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Each pie represents one Visium spot. Pie slices show the complete inferred
# CARD cell-type mixture within that spot.

CARD_pie_colors <- stats::setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(
    length(CARD_cell_types)
  ),
  CARD_cell_types
)


for (sample_name in names(CARD_results)) {

  current_proportions <- as.data.frame(
    CARD_results[[sample_name]]$proportions,
    check.names = FALSE
  )


  current_coordinates <- as.data.frame(
    CARD_results[[sample_name]]$CARD_object@spatial_location
  )


  common_plot_spots <- intersect(
    rownames(current_proportions),
    rownames(current_coordinates)
  )


  current_proportions <- current_proportions[
    common_plot_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  current_coordinates <- current_coordinates[
    common_plot_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  current_cell_types <- intersect(
    CARD_cell_types,
    colnames(current_proportions)
  )


  current_pie_proportions <- current_proportions[
    ,
    current_cell_types,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  current_pie_colors <- CARD_pie_colors[
    current_cell_types
  ]


  current_pie_plot <- CARD::CARD.visualize.pie(
    proportion = current_pie_proportions,
    spatial_location = current_coordinates,
    colors = current_pie_colors,
    radius = NULL,
    seed = 1234
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_titles[[sample_name]],
        " — CARD cell-type composition per spot"
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "right"
    )


  print(
    current_pie_plot
  )


  ggsave(
    file.path(
      figure_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_CARD_spot_composition_scatterpie.png"
      )
    ),
    current_pie_plot,
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. CARD all-cell-type spatial proportion panels
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# CARD-native continuous proportion maps are generated for every cell type on
# every slide using the original cornflowerblue-cornsilk-red scale.

for (sample_name in names(CARD_results)) {

  current_proportions <- as.data.frame(
    CARD_results[[sample_name]]$proportions,
    check.names = FALSE
  )


  current_coordinates <- as.data.frame(
    CARD_results[[sample_name]]$CARD_object@spatial_location
  )


  common_plot_spots <- intersect(
    rownames(current_proportions),
    rownames(current_coordinates)
  )


  current_proportions <- current_proportions[
    common_plot_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  current_coordinates <- current_coordinates[
    common_plot_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  current_cell_types <- intersect(
    CARD_cell_types,
    colnames(current_proportions)
  )


  CARD_all_cell_types_plot <- CARD::CARD.visualize.prop(
    proportion = current_proportions,
    spatial_location = current_coordinates,
    ct.visualize = current_cell_types,
    colors = card_proportion_colors,
    NumCols = 4,
    pointSize = 1
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_titles[[sample_name]],
        " — CARD proportions: all SingleR cell types"
      ),
      color = "Relative\nproportion"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )


  print(
    CARD_all_cell_types_plot
  )


  panel_height <- max(
    9,
    3.2 * ceiling(length(current_cell_types) / 4)
  )


  ggsave(
    file.path(
      figure_directory,
      paste0(
        sample_name,
        "_CARD_all_cell_type_proportions.png"
      )
    ),
    CARD_all_cell_types_plot,
    width = 16,
    height = panel_height,
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Mean CARD cell-type composition by sample
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CARD_mean_proportions <- CARD_proportions %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(
      spot,
      sample
    ),
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    cell_type
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_proportion = mean(
      proportion,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    normalized_mean_proportion =
      mean_proportion / sum(mean_proportion, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


write.csv(
  CARD_mean_proportions,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "CARD_mean_proportion_by_sample.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


CARD_composition_colors <- stats::setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(
    length(CARD_cell_types)
  ),
  CARD_cell_types
)


CARD_mean_composition_plot <- ggplot(
  CARD_mean_proportions,
  aes(
    x = factor(
      sample,
      levels = sample_order
    ),
    y = normalized_mean_proportion,
    fill = cell_type
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = CARD_composition_colors
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(
      accuracy = 1
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean CARD cell-type composition by sample",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean inferred CARD proportion",
    fill = "Cell type"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 35,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )


print(
  CARD_mean_composition_plot
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "CARD_mean_cell_type_composition_by_sample.png"
  ),
  CARD_mean_composition_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Relative CARD abundance heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Absolute CARD proportions are strongly influenced by abundant populations.
# For visualization, mean proportions are standardized within each cell type
# across samples. This highlights relative differences between tissue sections
# without altering the underlying CARD estimates.

CARD_relative_proportions <- CARD_mean_proportions %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cell_type
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    relative_abundance = as.numeric(
      scale(mean_proportion)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


CARD_relative_proportions$relative_abundance[
  !is.finite(CARD_relative_proportions$relative_abundance)
] <- 0


CARD_heatmap_order <- CARD_mean_proportions %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cell_type
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    overall_mean = mean(
      mean_proportion,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    overall_mean
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    cell_type
  )


CARD_relative_proportions <- CARD_relative_proportions %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell_type = factor(
      cell_type,
      levels = CARD_heatmap_order
    )
  )


CARD_relative_heatmap <- ggplot(
  CARD_relative_proportions,
  aes(
    x = factor(
      sample,
      levels = sample_order
    ),
    y = cell_type,
    fill = relative_abundance
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "#F7F7F7",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Relative\nabundance"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relative CARD cell-type proportions across samples",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )


print(
  CARD_relative_heatmap
)


heatmap_height <- max(
  6,
  0.35 * length(CARD_heatmap_order) + 2
)


ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "CARD_relative_cell_type_proportion_heatmap.png"
  ),
  CARD_relative_heatmap,
  width = 8,
  height = heatmap_height,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white",
  limitsize = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Save final CARD-annotated spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  spatial_object,
  final_CARD_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


CARD_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "reference_assay",
    "reference_cell_type_column",
    "spatial_assay",
    "spatial_sample_column",
    "minCountGene",
    "minCountSpot",
    "random_seed"
  ),
  value = c(
    reference_assay,
    reference_cell_type_column,
    spatial_assay,
    spatial_sample_column,
    CARD_min_count_gene,
    CARD_min_count_spot,
    1234
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  CARD_parameters,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "CARD_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


message(
  "Module 13 complete: CARD deconvolution completed for ",
  length(CARD_results),
  " spatial slides and transferred to the final spatial object."
)
```
